title: Schedule for Pre-Board Examinations for Class X and XII
body:
The first phase of CBSE Pre-Board examinations for Class X and XII will commence according to the academic calendar. Detailed date sheets and reporting instructions have been distributed in classrooms. 

Students must carry their official school ID card and arrive in complete winter uniform by 8:15 AM sharp.
